acceptanceCriteria: Every host and surface has an exact current tuple and FULL, FALLBACK or UNSUPPORTED result.
A tuple whose host API cannot supply required authority or identity is explicitly external-dependent and cannot block Core unless the owner keeps that policy.
No product-name-wide support claim is inferred from one surface.
body: Close the accepted host matrix where evidence is obtainable and downgrade uncloseable tuples honestly. This ticket does not weaken accepted intent without an owner decision.
title: Close or honestly downgrade the supported-host matrix
